name: 白羽の丘陵
notes: Source r11 upper envelope resampled and locally smoothed, retaining the source mountain form.
Continuous shared-edge retopology repairs holes and stacked skin. This is a ray-projected TRELLIS source surface, not a replacement primitive.
Accepted meadow-ground texture reused; world-space material treatment blends terrain and cave apron.
All upward faces, including steep slopes, contribute to the 0.4m physical height field.
River-side relief capped to a broad 0.72 grade shoulder, avoiding the former compressed vertical turf skirt.
Apron fitted below the measured cave floor until the actual rock arch; exact roof texture avoids cutting sky gaps around the mouth.
Source-derived 24,499-triangle LOD is used outside the camp/cave detail area, including views from the castle; the measured gameplay height field is unchanged.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS.2 (GGUF/C++), 1024 geometry, seed 42, 512 texture flow, 2048 atlas
provenance.workflow: Source image → TRELLIS.2 → source-preserving QEM → terrain fitting/UV/materials → exact GLB QA → source-envelope retopology and smoothing → measured surface comparison
